name: A Date With CyYu
source:
Have you ever wanted to date a cyborg seiyuu? Now's your chance! Enjoy a couple of cute moments with CyYu, the prettiest woman you've ever been blessed to be in the same room as! Can you impress her?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/a-date-with-cyyu]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你曾经想和半机械人声优约会吗？现在你的机会来了！与CyYu一起享受一些可爱的时刻，CyYu是你有幸与她共处一室的最漂亮的女人！你能给她留下深刻印象吗？

[来自[url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/a-date-with-cyyu]Itch.io[/url]]
